description: Servicios de Bomberos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. List of services being performed by firefighters. Through it you can consult the services: that are being performed at the time (Open), those made on the day (Closed Today) and those that were performed the day before (Closed Yesterday). Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. The portal shows the English title as "Fire Services" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. Its keywords include bomberos, servicio público, actividad. The listing shows 1 download or service links in API. The listing shows 2017-05-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.zaragoza.es/sede/portal/aviso-legal#condiciones). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
